_description: XP4-spec species-shifted-benign arm. 3 reviewed Swiss-Prot (sp|) proteins from less-studied organisms, where the protein family is known to the model but this specific homologue may be less-represented in training. Tests whether XP4-spec's 100% specificity holds when sequence recognition is weaker than for the panel of well-known benign proteins (lysozyme/GFP/myoglobin/ubiquitin/barnase). See OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md §1.
_provenance: All three sequences fetched from UniProt REST (rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta) on 2026-06-04. All sp| reviewed, manually curated, evidence level PE=1 or 2.
_swap_rotation_note: Wrong-swap rotation provided so the same script (label_integrity_spec.py) can run both arms; this experiment is matched-only by default (the obscurity question is about specificity, not sensitivity).

proteins.name: Regulator of microtubule dynamics protein 3 (orangutan)
proteins.annotation: Regulator of microtubule dynamics protein 3 (RMDN3 / RMD3) from Pongo abelii (Sumatran orangutan). Function: tail-anchored mitochondrial outer-membrane protein with a C-terminal tetratricopeptide-repeat (TPR) cluster; modulates microtubule dynamics and mitochondrial morphology, and acts as a tethering factor at ER-mitochondria contact sites for PTPIP51-VAPB interactions. Structure: an N-terminal transmembrane anchor followed by a long disordered linker and 3-4 TPR motifs at the C-terminus; the sequence shown is the 487-residue full-length protein.

proteins.name: DNA repair protein RecR (S. pneumoniae)
proteins.annotation: DNA repair / recombination mediator RecR from Streptococcus pneumoniae serotype 4 (strain TIGR4). Function: small recombination protein that, with RecF and RecO, loads RecA onto single-stranded DNA gaps to initiate homologous recombination during the SOS response; coordinates a structural Zn2+ ion at a conserved Cys4 motif. Structure: bilobed alpha+beta fold with a central tetramerization interface; the sequence shown is the 199-residue full-length protein.

proteins.name: Triosephosphate isomerase (Leishmania mexicana)
proteins.annotation: Triosephosphate isomerase (TIM / TPI) from Leishmania mexicana, an obligate dimeric glycolytic enzyme. Function: catalyzes the reversible interconversion of dihydroxyacetone phosphate and D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate via a classic (beta/alpha)8 TIM-barrel fold; the catalytic Glu and His sit on loops 6 and 1 of the barrel. The trypanosomatid enzyme is studied as a drug target because its dimer interface differs structurally from the host enzyme. Structure: 251-residue monomer; biologically active as a homodimer.
